text.printed:
During step 2 of the villain phase, Hammerhead activates against you before The Punisher does.
Forced Response: After a friendly character attacks Hammerhead, stun that character.
When Defeated: If Hammerhead was defeated by The Punisher, place 1[per_hero] threat on the main scheme.
